questions.title: Order matters inside the bracket
questions.prompt: The point $(4,1)$ lies on $y=f(x)$. Describe the transformations that map $y=f(x)$ onto $y=f(2x+6)$, in order, and find the image of $(4,1)$.

steps.d: $f(2x+6)=f(2(x+3))$: dilate by $\tfrac12$ horizontally, then shift left 3.

traps.why: Shifted left 6 before halving; factorise as 2(x + 3) first.

questions.title: Tracking a single point

traps.why: Added f(2) instead of subtracting it.

questions.title: Area under a transformed graph

hints: How does replacing x by 2x change widths?
How does multiplying by 3 change heights?

traps.why: f(2x) compresses horizontally; it does not double the area.

questions.title: Absolute value against a steep line
questions.prompt: Using the graphs shown, solve $|x+1|>2x-1$.
hints: Read where the V is higher.

steps.d: For $x\ge-1$: $x+1=2x-1\Rightarrow x=2$; the other arm gives $x=0$, not on it.
The V is above the line for $x<2$.

traps.why: There the line is above the V.

questions.title: Sine against a gentle line
questions.prompt: The graphs of $y=\sin x$ and $y=\dfrac x2$ are shown. How many solutions does $\sin x=\dfrac x2$ have? Explain.

steps.d: At $O$ the sine curve has gradient $1>\tfrac12$, so it is above the line just right of $O$
For $x\ge2$ the line is at least $1$; one crossing in $(0,2)$, one by symmetry, plus $O$
